correctness.rationale: For real degree-three spherical harmonics on normalized unit S^2, the tensor T is symmetric trace-free and E=||T||^2>0; B_ij=sum_{kl}T_ikl T_jkl is PSD with tr B=E. Direct exact rational monomial integration in a seven-dimensional harmonic basis verifies the *universal* polynomial identities ∫h²=2E/35 and ∫h⁴=4E²/715+(24/5005)tr(B²). They imply the stated ratio 315/143+(210/(143 E²))||B-EI/3||_F². Matrix-square nonnegativity gives sharpness and iff equality, with xyz realizing B=EI/3. Nonisotropic x(x²−3y²) has ratio 350/143. This is an all-coefficient identity, not finite sampling; the result asserts no orbit classification.
